card.title: Samsung Galaxy S7 USB device not recognised. No data transfer.

source.title: Samsung Galaxy S7 USB device not recognised. No data transfer.

claims.statement: After a known-good charge port, Galaxy S7 / S7 Edge data faults are in R8019, R8020 (2.2 Ω 0603, part 2007-008774) or diodes ZD8008, ZD8009 (part 0406-001690).

procedure: Replace the charge port with a known-good one.
Test R8019/R8020 and ZD8008/ZD8009; replace faulty ones.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
